import urllib.request, urllib.parse, json
base='https://geo.salvador.ba.gov.br/arcgis/rest/services/Hosted/catalogo_geoservicos/FeatureServer'
def get(url,params=None):
    if params: url += ('&' if '?' in url else '?') + urllib.parse.urlencode(params)
    with urllib.request.urlopen(url,timeout=30) as r: return json.loads(r.read().decode('utf-8'))
meta=get(base,{'f':'json'})
print('CATALOG_LAYERS',[(x.get('id'),x.get('name')) for x in meta.get('layers',[])])
for lyr in meta.get('layers',[]):
    lm=get(base+'/'+str(lyr['id']),{'f':'json'})
    print('LAYER',lyr['id'],lyr.get('name'),'FIELDS',[(f.get('name'),f.get('alias')) for f in lm.get('fields',[])])
    q=get(base+'/'+str(lyr['id'])+'/query',{'f':'json','where':'1=1','outFields':'*','returnGeometry':'false','resultRecordCount':2000})
    feats=q.get('features',[])
    print('FEATURES',len(feats))
    terms=('altim','curva','nivel','nível','mdt','mde','lidar','laser','relevo','cota','sicad','topograf','elev')
    hits=[]
    for ft in feats:
        a=ft.get('attributes',{})
        s=' | '.join(str(v) for v in a.values() if v is not None).lower()
        if any(t in s for t in terms): hits.append(a)
    print('HITS',len(hits))
    for a in hits[:120]: print('CAT_HIT',json.dumps(a,ensure_ascii=False,default=str))
print('CATALOG_QUERY_DONE')
